description: The 4.1 ganesha standing as a pNFS METADATA server: LAYOUTGET, LAYOUTCOMMIT, LAYOUTRETURN and GETDEVICEINFO are required rather than explored, so failing to advertise EXCHGID4_FLAG_USE_PNFS_MDS is a failure and not a skip. A single-node ganesha over a local filesystem is not a metadata server, so in practice this cell reports a ctest SKIP -- which is the point: the gap stays visible and attributable.
